payload.title: SEO for aligning Jev and decision models: sitemap, article schema, hub page
payload.description: Ryan, 2026-09-27: win search for 'fine-tune Jev', 'fine-tune decision model', 'align Jev to your data'. Added: gatsby-plugin-sitemap with robots.txt pointing at the index; Article JSON-LD and og:type article on every published article; a hub page at /decision-models with FAQPage JSON-LD answering the six questions people search with, each answered from published figures and linked to its article; 'decision model' added to seven Jev article descriptions and one title; research intro and the homepage machine-learning box link to the hub. No body-text stuffing.
